title: Three visually similar wolves in the Vale wood are framed inconsistently with no warning: the ash wolf at Twin Stones is flagged as peaceful-if-left-alone ('It holds its ground and will let you pass if you let it be,' and Lys advises leaving it), while the gaunt wolf one tile away at Wolf Scrape and the lean wolf at Charcoal Ring are both 'hostile, attacks on sight' — the only way to learn which is which is to walk up to each one.
